segments.text: Third prince of the Kingdom of Regalia. His mother, Dede, passed away when he was five years old. Because his mother was a slave turned concubine, he was never in contention for the throne.
At the age of 20, he was assigned as a count to the worst territory in the kingdom, Borondo. A territory notorious for suffering from famines.
On his way to Borondo, he encounters a female magician who has lost her donkey. He gives her his horse and in return she gives him a magic lamp.
In Regalia, princes and kings have magicians as a spiritual protector, tutor, and advisor, but Leen does not have one of his own.
Instead he has a trio assassins who serve as his guards. They also serve as his magicians, if you could call them that.
He is not good at swordsmanship, but he is quick on his feet. He is a proficient swimmer and a talented painter.
From official site
レガリア王国の第三王子。
5歳の時に母デーデが他界。
母は奴隷だったため、王位争いからは外れている。
第一王子のタラキン、第二王子のキラルとは違って、将来王位を継ぐ者とは見なされていない。
二十歳をきっかけに、国内で最も石高の低いボロンド伯領へ伯として赴任。
ボロンド伯リーンとなる。ボロンドへ向かう途中、ロバを失った女魔術師に遭遇。
自分の馬を与え、お礼に魔法のランプを譲り受ける。
レガリアでは王子や王には霊的護衛兼家庭教師兼ご意見番として魔術師がつくものだが、リーンには専属の魔術師はつかいていない。
代わりに護衛&適当な霊的護衛として暗殺者三人組がついている。
剣技は得意ではないが、足は速い。泳ぐのも絵を描くのも得意である。

Member of one of the many succubus tribes living on Mt Sabato. She speaks in a gal-like and easygoing manner.
The succubi are a race of dancers, famous for elegant dances in the sky. Those who possess rare magic lamps can summon a succubus.
They detest the label of being "whore demons", in reality, they will only have sex with those they have fallen in love with. This does not make them 100% harmless.
If a person becomes disrespectful or unruly towards a succubus, they will be punished with a handjob that can kill. The killer move is called the "die die dance".
Belbel meets Leen when she is summoned by a magic lamp.

ちょっとギャルっぽい砕けた話し方をする。
サキュバスは基本的に踊り子の種族で、空を舞う流麗な踊りで有名。

といっても、100%無害で安全な存在というわけではない。

リーンとは魔法のランプで呼び出されて出会う。
居住在萨巴托山的魅魔一族成员。
说话风格略带辣妹式的随意感。
魅魔本质上是以舞姬为业的种族，以在空中翩翩起舞的华丽舞姿闻名。
可通过魔法神灯召唤。
并非见男就袭的所谓淫魔。
魅魔女性只会与中意之人交合。
但绝非完全无害的温顺存在。
若召唤者是以色欲为目的的无礼之徒，
便会与同伴施展手〇榨精之技，将对方折磨至半死不活的状态。

Princess of the neighboring kingdom of Faria, a kingdom of elves. She is famous for her beautiful breasts. She is very calm and shows little emotion.
She has resigned herself to the fact that princesses have no freedom and are merely tools of diplomacy. She is ordered by her father to enter a political marriage, for the kingdom.
Her suitors are prince Tarakin and Kiral of the Kingdom of Regalia. She is completely put off by their objectifying behavior. The idea of marriage to either, is the cause of her anxiety.
She has complex about her inverted nipples.

A female knight of the Kingdom of Regalia. She is a rather talented swordsman and belongs to the elite royal guard.
She met Leen when they were children. She has always beaten Leen, or rather, Lean is no match for Sonia. Since Leen is weak, she does not respect him as much as she should.
As Leen becomes more influential by becoming the Count of Galicia, Queen Zamasu begins to impose her will on Sonia to do her bidding.

リーンとは小さい頃に知り合った。

She is bold and daring. When Leen becomes the count of Galicia, she comes all the way to the reception hall to see him even though she knows she is being targeted.
She is an excellent leader and her crew follows her loyally. She is also a good cook, and her crew sometimes beg her to cook for them.

She is a young but very talented magician. In fact, she is one of the most powerful magicians in the country.
Many believed that it was only a matter of time before she earned the position of high priestess. But before she could, she resigned due to a conflict with her superiors.
While wandering around the country trying to become someone's personal magician, the donkey she was riding died.
It was Leen who helped her out by giving her his horse, in return, Nephilia gives him a magic lamp.
She is adept at water magic, and when she kills someone, she summons super sized wash bowls to crush their heads.

Her sister, Zirgund serves Kiral.

Queen of Regalia and mother of Prince Tarakin. She speaks in a sarcastic tone when she gets angry.
Since Kiral and Leen's mothers have already died, she is the only surviving queen and mother of the princes.
She is trying to use her position as queen to exert her influence to help her beloved son ascend the throne.
She is an incredibly talented magician, and serves as her son's personal magician.
From official site
レガリア王国王妃。
タラキン王子の母。キレるとざます口調でしゃべる。
キラルとリーンの母はすでに亡くなっているので、王子の生母としてはただ一人の生き残り。
王妃の立場を利用して影響力を発揮し、溺愛する息子をなんとかして王位に即けようとしている。
かつては相当実力のある魔術師だった。いまでも息子の魔術師をしている。
First prince of the Kingdom of Regalia. He is the count of the territory of Jurgia, which is adjacent to the king's territory.
He is the only prince whose mother is still alive, and he is doted upon by her. He often gets upset when Leen calls him "Tamakin", in return he calls him "slave" in an abusive manner.
He and Prince Kiral are also on bad terms, and things get worse when they compete to win over Luchesis, the large breasted princess of the neighboring Kingdom of Faria.
When things don't go his way, he often ends up crying to his mother.
From official site
レガリア王国の第一王子。
王領地に隣接するユルギア伯領を領地とする。ユルギア伯タラキン。
母は魔術師の王妃ザマス。3人の王子の中で唯一母親が生きており母親の庇護のもとで溺愛されている。
リーンによく「タマキン」と名前を間違われては怒っているが、タラキン自身もリーンを「おい、奴隷」とかなりひどい呼び方をしている。
王子キラルとは犬猿の仲。
隣国ファリア王国の超乳王女ルキシスをものにしようとしているが、まったく靡かずママに泣きつくことになる。
Second prince of the Kingdom of Regalia. He is the count of the territory of Germea. His mother is Queen Gilia who has passed away.
He is an overconfident man with a haughty voice. He is handsome and is quite popular with women. As a candidate for king, he has always been Tarakin's rival.
His magician and personal guard is the knight Lancegill. Leen often mistakes his name as "Kirel" which angers him, and in return calls him "ugly" to make fun of him.

He is trying to win over Luchesis, the large breasted princess from the neighboring kingdom of Faria, but she is not easily won over, and he is having a hard time with women for the first time in his life.
From official site
レガリア王国の第二王子。
ゲルメア伯領を領地とする。ゲルメア伯キラル。
母は大貴族の娘（故人）
オレサマ口調で自信満々。黒髪の美男子でかなりモテる。
国王候補として常にタラキンのライバルであり。そのため、タラキンとは犬猿の仲。
お抱え魔術師兼護衛は騎士ランズギル。
リーンによく「キレル」と間違われて怒っているが、キラル自身もリーンを、「おいブサメン」「醜男」と呼んで馬鹿にしている。
隣国ファリア王国の超巨乳王女ルキシスをものにしようとしているが、なかなか靡かず、初めて女で苦戦する。
King of Regalia. Father of Tarakin, Kiral, and Leen. Married to Queen Zamasu and the late Queen Gilia. Dede, his beloved concubine has also passed away.
He rules the kingdom with the help of Merceus, who serves as his personal magician, high priest, and prime minister. He is regarded as “a very intelligent king” by the king of the elves.
From official site
They say they have known Leen since he was a baby. They are Leen's bodyguards, but prefer to call themselves his assassins.
They are Leen's swordsmanship teachers and are relentless in their teaching. They always beat Leen to a pulp, but say that it's tough love.
They say that their real names are "Ahonasu", "Bakanasu", and "Charanasu". Leen does not know their actual names but understands that they have their reasons to hide it.
For some reason, they are very strong against demons.
From official site
Count of the territory of Galicia. Old and suffering from illness, he is aware that he will soon pass away.
He has not yet named a successor to his territory, but he trusts that King Azrald I will do a good job in selecting one.
He is fiercely loyal to King Azrald I.
Coming from poor nobility, he saw not many options to raise his status. He chose the path of magic to better his life.
He saved King Azrald I from a curse when he was visiting his territory. Since then, he has served as his personal magician, advisor, and prime minister.
The personal guard and magician of Kiral. He is a man of few words, and is careful in choosing his words. He is loyal to Kiral, and tries his best to fix his behavior.
He is the kingdom's strongest knight and leader of the royal guard. He is also proficient enough in magic to be Kiral's personal magician.
He is the count of the territory of Gale in the Kingdom of Faria. He also serves as the retainer and magician for Princess Luchesis.
He deeply cares about the Princess' wellbeing and would prefer that she marry for love but understands the necessity of a political marriage.
King of the Kingdom of Faria and father of Luchesis. He is always interested in expanding his Kingdom and has clashed with the Kingdom of Regalia over land in the past.
Although he has some reservations, he is willing to his use his daughter as a tool of diplomacy and marry her off to the crown prince of Regalia.
The count of the territory of Borondo, or at least he used to be until he was demoted to deputy with the arrival of Leen.
Greedy and self serving, he is willing to allow his territory to fall into decay if it means he stays well fed and wealthy.
Wardanov's advisor and servant. Fiercely loyal to his master he is willing to do anything for him.
Nothing annoys him more then when his name is mispronounced as Chin Po.
Brother of Agori. He uses his formidable size to his advantage when fighting. He serves as a guard for Wardanov.
Brother of Igori. He uses his formidable size to his advantage when fighting. He serves as a guard for Wardanov.
